entries.title: Git commit after US close — protocol step
entries.what_changed: Formalized flow: /complete-us + /sync-board then human commit (one US per commit). Agents add suggested commit in Record Executed; no auto-commit on ✅ unless manager asks.
entries.why_changed: US could be ✅ in docs while git stayed dirty; commit was outside the documented Meridian loop.
entries.impact: Managers and agents follow the same close → commit sequence; aligns with US-0071 (last commit on docs/us) and existing conventional commits.

entries.title: Story Detail — depends_on drill-down shipped (US-0085)
entries.affected_document: docs/us/US-0085.md, linked-stories-list.tsx, StoryDetailSheet.tsx, story-detail-summary.tsx, deliverable-doc-sheet.tsx, KanbanView.tsx
entries.what_changed: US-0085 closed: LinkedStoriesList for depends_on and sprint storyIds; StoryDetailSheet stacks dependency sheets with modal/allowOutsideDismiss; board.json updated.
entries.why_changed: Managers could see depends_on as comma-separated text but could not navigate the chain inside Story Detail.
entries.impact: EPIC-11 follow-up complete for US depends_on navigation; blocks/reverse links still out of scope.

entries.title: Story Detail — clickable depends_on drill-down (US-0085)
entries.affected_document: docs/us/US-0085.md, story-detail-summary.tsx, StoryDetailSheet.tsx, linked-stories-list.tsx, deliverable-doc-sheet.tsx, KanbanView.tsx
entries.what_changed: Refined US-0085: replace comma-separated depends_on with LinkedStoriesList rows; StoryDetailSheet stacks a second sheet for dependencies using the same modal/allowOutsideDismiss pattern as sprint→story (US-0083).
entries.why_changed: US-0081 exposed depends_on in summary but not as navigation; managers still leave Story Detail to follow dependency chains on the Board.
entries.impact: Implement US-0085 after US-0081/0083; no parser or board.json schema change.

entries.title: Open folder — deterministic session reset (US-0084)
entries.what_changed: Refined US-0084: every Open folder runs beginFolderOpen() (clear binding + generation guards) before picker; bind failure never restores status open; AbortError rolls back prior session; enrichment errors surface in issues banner; Vitest for state helpers.
entries.why_changed: Dogfooding hit silent half-open state when openFolder catch reused folderKeyRef and ProjectDataContext swallowed enrichment errors — managers re-opened folder repeatedly.
entries.impact: Implement via US-0084 before US-0051/0059; no architecture doc version bump until code lands.

entries.title: Deliverables — nested Story Detail sheet over sprint sheet
entries.what_changed: US-0083 defines stacked sheets: sprint deliverable stays open (base layer) while StoryDetailSheet opens on nested layer; closing story returns to sprint only.
entries.why_changed: Sprint panel listed US as plain text; managers lost sprint context when drilling into a story via Board.
entries.impact: Deliverables sprint review is self-contained; version/epic drill-down deferred.

entries.title: Roadmap realignment — v2 kanban, v3 complete, VS Code → v4
entries.affected_document: docs/versions/v2.md–v8.md, docs/epics/EPIC-04.md, EPIC-05.md, EPIC-07–10.md, docs/sprints/v2-S4..v8, docs/us/US-0041..0072 (version frontmatter), docs/README.md, docs/kanban/board.json
entries.what_changed: v2 redefined as Kanban and board polish (EPIC-04), status active. v3 Monitor UI/UX marked complete (EPIC-11). VS Code bridge (EPIC-05) moved from v2 to v4 planned. Authoring v4→v5, Export v5→v6, Tauri v3→v7, Vision v6→v8. Sprint files renamed accordingly; US-0051 stays v2/EPIC-04 (stale board).
entries.why_changed: Delivery order diverged from docs: monitor kanban and UI shipped while v2 still labeled Visual Studio Bridge and v3 still planned; EPIC-04 work was conflated with extension scope.
entries.impact: Active release is v2 (close US-0051 or defer); next product slice is v4 extension. Board.json regenerated. Historical decision entries unchanged.

entries.title: Monitor loading — frontmatter index instead of full snapshot
entries.affected_document: docs/05_architecture.md, docs/us/US-0076.md, docs/sprints/v2-S6.md, docs/versions/v2.md, project-loader.ts, ProjectDataContext.tsx
entries.what_changed: Planned US-0076 (v2-S6): on folder open, build a lightweight index (list + frontmatter parse) instead of loading all markdown bodies into React state. Full files read on demand via FileSystemDirectoryHandle when opening sheets/readers. Sprint v2-S6 added to v2.
entries.why_changed: Monolithic loadMeridianProject caused slow open and indefinite loading spinner on dogfood docs/ (75+ US); disk is already source of truth — mirroring entire tree in memory is the wrong model for browser v1 monitor.
entries.impact: 05_architecture.md v1.2 documents current vs index-first target under Loading. Implementation via /refine-us US-0076 then code. US-0059 watcher can refresh index only later.
